Synopsis:
Russia's Foreign Minister Lavrov publicly declared NATO's Arctic Sentry mission and regional military exercises a direct security threat, warning of rising armed confrontation risks. NATO members, notably Norway, are expanding Arctic military infrastructure post-Ukraine invasion. Russia retains dominant Arctic military presence including nuclear submarines, while China increasingly partners with Moscow in the mineral-rich region. The US dimension is present via Trump's Greenland acquisition push, adding geopolitical pressure to an already tense theater.
